title: Historical Signal Query + Downsampling Foundation
objective: Build the bounded signal-series query and deterministic downsampling foundation a historical Plot will consume, on top of the existing persisted CAN DataSession + Query + DBC decode, WITHOUT creating a second historical data engine and WITHOUT building the Plot UI. Signal identity is never just a signal name: it carries channel_id, asset_id, message identity and signal identity, semantically consistent with the V0.3 realtime Plot SignalSelection, and two same-named signals on different channels are never merged into one series. The source of truth is Project -> registered DataSession -> verified Parquet segments -> QueryService / QueryEngine -> canonical Frame -> verified project-owned DBC -> DbcDecoder -> signal series; no frontend cache as authority, no loading a whole project into pandas, no loading a whole DataSession, no bypassing segment integrity, no globbing project files and assuming trust. Historical reads are paged/chunked/bounded/deterministic, so memory does not grow linearly with the dataset. Add a Runtime-side deterministic downsampling that maps a large dataset to a bounded PlotSample series preserving first point, last point and significant extrema better than a blind stride, with stable deterministic output, a strict maximum result bound and ordered timestamps. Streaming must use bounded page -> decode -> online/bucket aggregation -> discard, so working memory tracks page size + sample budget, not dataset size. Downsampling lives in the Runtime, not only the frontend; the realtime series.ts stride is not simply copied as the large-data answer.
scope: runtime/canx/query/** and the new runtime/canx/plot/** domain package, their tests, and the V0.4-04 acceptance document.
non_goals: Any full Plot UI (V0.4-05), zoom/pan/cursor (V0.4-06) or marker/overlay (V0.4-07)
Any HTTP/public API surface (the domain/service contract is frozen first; a Desktop consumer is deferred)
Any complex WebGL renderer or React dependency
Modifying runtime/canx/api/**, runtime/canx/recorder/**, runtime/canx/replay/**, runtime/canx/safety/** or apps/desktop/**
Writing runtime/canx/dbc/** (read-only dependency): a DBC change is BLOCK-and-replan, not an in-place edit
acceptance_criteria: Historical signal identity carries channel_id, asset_id, message identity and signal identity; same-named signals on different channels stay separate series
Historical reads are paged/chunked/bounded and deterministic; a very large session does not grow memory linearly with dataset size
Downsampling preserves first point, last point and a significant spike better than a blind stride, is deterministic across repeats and strictly bounds output_count <= requested sample budget
Output timestamps are ordered; channel/asset/message/signal isolation is preserved
An invalid or tampered DBC asset fails closed; an invalid project/session and a window with no matching signal are handled explicitly
No HTTP/public API surface is added and no full Plot UI is built
handoff_requirements: RED evidence first for each new behaviour
Exact commands and results for the targeted query/plot tests, pytest -q, ruff and mypy

The large-data test proving output_count <= requested sample budget and that the working set is not the whole input dataset; benchmark numbers where they are stable, without brittle wall-clock CI thresholds
State explicitly that no file outside allowed_paths was touched and that runtime/canx/dbc/** and runtime/canx/api/** are byte-identical to base_sha
